title: Original ATV artwork and local player lineup
summary: The garage picker uses the recovered QUADINFO multi_atv artwork, while local split-screen setup gains a colored, side-by-side Players lineup.
details: The lineup draws on recovered PAGE08 MultiATVRiderSelect evidence. The original reference is an approximate composite assembled from recovered assets, not a hardware capture.
PR #692 merged as ef75a951e5079fa871bea42e12ae2920eebb140c. Final code head b853c1d passed web and desktop/Android CI.

The implementation owner tested exact CI artifact 43673928019: split_seats passed in 23.2 seconds. Focused garage checks passed six host-browser viewports (390x664, 390x844, 844x330, 844x390, 820x1180, 1280x800), touch selection and reopening, keyboard dismissal and two whole side-by-side cards.

Independently inspected final phone portrait garage and joined Players screenshots in garage-692-v2-focused and garage-692-v2-split. Screenshot publication remains pending production deployment and validated R2 gallery publication.
The full phone suite fails the unrelated Single Player scroll assertion. The owner reproduced the identical 135.86499px result on unchanged production fe0d904c at 390x664.
limitation: Host browser checks do not establish physical-phone behavior or original-game visual fidelity. Motorcycle and remote online roster previews remain unfinished. Production still reported fe0d904c when the validated deployed artifact was fetched; no final screenshots have been published.
